title: Fake Club Fee
scenario: A message says you must pay today to keep your place in a school club.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Fake Club Fee: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: School fees should be confirmed through the school or club leader.
